title: RossFast post-Status-A current-canonical preservation and closeout

live_canonical_delta_from_status_a.note: 992a5c6 to 523da7a changes only Status-A documentation/governance files.

status_a_scope_relationship.interpretation: The pinned Status-A release-readiness denominator explicitly excludes ROSS/RossFast. This workunit is a separately scoped post-Status-A capability preservation decision and does not retroactively broaden the Status-A release claim.

preserved_contract: typed explicit application model selection and configuration
external config-file adapter as an explicit adapter rather than automatic discovery
transactional execution and exactly-once accepted commit
fail-closed invalid, mixed and missing configuration
Reference Richards preserved and not captured by RossFast

dependency_delta.f_kt22_relevant_change_before_f_ci81: F-KT22 changed direct F-ROSS11 dependencies before the final F-CI81 scientific qualification. The earlier pre-F-KT22 qualification was correctly superseded.
dependency_delta.aa25126_to_50346642: Later WOFOST, groundwater, Snow and governance work added other surfaces, but no direct F-CI81 dependency file changed.
dependency_delta.50346642_to_992a5c65: Only the Status-A release-readiness record was added; no production or reference file changed.
dependency_delta.992a5c65_to_523da7aa: Documentation/governance-only refresh; no production or reference file changed.

qualification.reason: The final independent F-CI81 qualification was already executed after the only relevant dependency change, and all direct dependency plus F-ROSS11 production blobs remain byte-identical on the scientific baseline, Status-A authority and live canonical host.
evidence_reused: F-CI80 primary and successor restricted-stack qualification and postimage preservation evidence

admit.reason: F-ROSS02 through F-ROSS10 and F-ROSS11 are already present in canonical history and in the pinned scientific production tree. Re-admitting identical production would create no new semantics.

deliberately_unsupported_scientific_doma: root or general distributed source/sink RossFast support
arbitrary heterogeneous profile or grid support
scientific domain broadening beyond the qualified six-material restricted D3R envelope

minimum_next_bounded_capability.proposed_name: F-ROSS12 production host and explicit user selection binding
minimum_next_bounded_capability.goal: Connect the already qualified typed F-ROSS11 application composition to the normal SWAP5 application host through explicit user-selected model configuration, without changing RossFast science or transaction semantics.
minimum_contract: Reference remains the default path unless RossFast is explicitly selected.
Translate one normal application-level model selection into the existing typed F-ROSS09/F-ROSS11 configuration without duplicating semantic authority.
Require explicit RossFast asset-root/config inputs and preflight them before state mutation.
Invoke F-ROSS11 only for the already qualified restricted domain.
Fail closed on unsupported domain, missing assets, conflicting selection or unsupported mixed-backend execution.
Do not reinterpret SW_SOLVE or silently fall back between Reference and RossFast.
Preserve exactly-once accepted commit and Reference Richards isolation.
No EB, groundwater RossFast, root/source-sink generalization, heterogeneous-profile generalization or mixed-backend MultiSWAP.

mutations: No production source, table asset, reference path, scientific equation, transaction policy, API, IO grammar or host wiring changed.
next_permitted_action: Open a separate bounded F-ROSS12 host/user-selection capability only if normal SWAP5 application execution is to expose the already qualified restricted RossFast path.
